sql: SELECT d.d_date AS cal_date, d.d_holiday AS tpcds_d_holiday, h.holiday_name AS nager_holiday FROM TPCDS_DB.date_dim d LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = d.d_date AND h.is_national = true WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-06' AND DATE '2025-02-27' AND (d.d_holiday = 'Y' OR h.holiday_name IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY d.d_date LIMIT 500
